Hello all, 

I am excited to use shiny. I have had success whipping up a couple of shiny apps and after getting my spark access wanted to push one or two but I am getting the error below. do I need to do something unique in declaring packages to be published with shiny to spark? 

Thanks! 
Rich


Error in library(plotrix) : there is no package called ‘plotrix’ Calls: runApp ... eval -> source -> withVisible -> eval -> eval -> library Execution halted

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: error publishing to spark shiny server
parts:
It looks like you need to install the plotrix package. You can do that by logging into RStudio on Spark, and then installing the package the usual way:
  install.packages("plotrix")
